entities.summary: Marquis Guglielmo Imperiali was an Italian nobleman and diplomat. A liberal associated with the political left, he was a scion of the conservative Imperiali family. His most important position was as the Italian ambassador in London during the First World War (1914–18). Guglielmo Imperiali was a political leaders from Salerno (1858-08-19, Salerno–1944-01-20).
